name: Stir fried chicken with cashew nuts
notes: Eating Thai Food (200 g chicken breast, 1 tbsp cassava flour, 1/3 cup oil for frying everything, 4 garlic cloves, onion, roasted chilli paste, oyster and soy sauce for 2 plates) and Rachel Cooks Thai's chicken with roasted chilli paste (thighs, onion, peppers, 4 tbsp paste). Per plate 20 g of oil absorbed of the 1/3 cup used for frying; cashews 20 g.
